subject: Delegated provisioning & admin guardrails for Private Control Plane - mapping questions
messages:
From: Katie Hudson <katie.hudson@enterpriseco.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.example>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Private CP delegated provisioning - how do we limit admin scope?

Hi Sean,

We're starting the identity integration for our Private Control Plane and have a few operational questions before the workshop next week. High level: we want to allow our platform team to provision users and groups into the Private CP, but not give them full org-level admin. Specifics: 

- Can Redwood support a delegated admin role that is scoped to a single VPC/cluster? We want to avoid global org admins.
- For SCIM, do you support mapping SCIM groups -> internal roles (e.g., scim:priv-admins -> role:privcp_env_admin)?
- For SAML assertions, what attributes do you require for JIT provisioning vs. role assertion? Any preferred name/format?
- Are there recommended service account scopes for automated provisioning (limited to SCIM PATCH/POST)?
- Audit/logging: what fields are recorded when a user is provisioned (actor, source IP, request id)? Retention?

Appreciate any quick clarifications. If easier, we can cover in the workshop but we'd like to validate our IdP mapping ahead of time.

Thanks,
Katie
Katie Hudson
Head of Platform Ops | EnterpriseCo
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.example>
To: Katie Hudson <katie.hudson@enterpriseco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private CP delegated provisioning - how do we limit admin scope?

Thanks Katie — good set of questions. Looping in Marcus and Kimberly for the technical mappings and guardrails. Initial answers in brief here so you have something to compare to before the workshop: 

- Delegated admin: yes — we support a "Delegated Admin" role that can be pinned to a single Private CP deployment (VPC). It limits UI/console actions and API calls to that deployment only (no global org-level permissions). We'll send the role permissions matrix.
- SCIM groups: supported. Best practice is to prefix groups in your IdP (eg: rw_priv_admins, rw_priv_viewers) and then map those to Redwood roles via SCIM group->role mappings. We also support group->role mapping on SCIM PATCH for partial updates.
- SAML attributes: we recommend email, groups, and a custom attribute 'redwood:roles' for explicit role assertions when you don't want SCIM provisioning to be primary. For JIT provisioning, 'eduPersonScopedAffiliation' or 'memberOf' are acceptable but unstable — prefer explicit attributes.
- Service account: create a SCIM service principal with only PATCH/POST/GET permissions against /Users and /Groups. Avoid giving it token-management scopes.
- Audit logs: we capture actor (subject), source IP, request_id, action_type, target_resource, and timestamp. Retention is 90 days by default for Hosted; for Private we can configure retention per contract.

I'll attach a short playbook and an example SCIM schema for your IdP team. Marcus/Kimberly, feel free to add technical details. Katie, can we schedule a 60-min mapping session on Thurs?

—Sean
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Private CP delegated provisioning - how do we limit admin scope?

Adding technical detail from the runtime/onboarding perspective: 

- Role model: we use a resource-scoped role model for Private CP. Internally the binding looks like: 
  - resource: "privcp://<deployment-id>"
  - role: "privcp.delegated_admin"
  - principal: "user:<email>" or "group:<scim_group_id>"

- SCIM mapping notes: 
  - We support `members` arrays in Group PATCH operations. Map your IdP group -> Redwood role via the group.displayName -> role mapping table. 
  - For first-time imports, use bulk create then incremental PATCH for deltas. Bulk import will preserve local role bindings if the external id is sent.

- SAML/JIT: if you use SAML for daily sign-on + JIT, ensure assertions include `eduPersonTargetedID` (or a stable NameID) and `redwood:roles` when you want to skip SCIM for role assignment. We will fall back to SCIM for authoritative group membership if both are present.

- Service account IP and firewall: many customers restrict SCIM calls to a NAT IP range. We'll provide our SCIM egress IPs for Private CP connector. Also recommend mutual TLS for SCIM webhook endpoints if your IdP supports it.

I'll attach a sample mapping file and a short script we use for delta reconciliation (included in the playbook).

—Marcus
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Private CP delegated provisioning - how do we limit admin scope?

Operational/process notes from the onboarding/security side: 

- Delegated admin shape: we typically create two variants — `delegated_admin_readwrite` and `delegated_admin_readonly` scoped to the deployment. Delegated_admin_readwrite can create users/groups, manage role bindings for that deployment, and trigger service restarts; it cannot modify org billing or create new Private CP deployments.

- Session/JIT controls: we support an optional SAML attribute `redwood:max_session_minutes` to limit session durations for delegated admins (useful for break-glass access). If absent, the default session is 8 hours.

- Audit requirements: include `request_id` in SCIM calls (we record it on our side). When you run manual provisioning via the console we add `console_user` in the audit entry. For compliance reviews we can output CSV exports of provisioning events filtered by deployment_id and actor.

Example SAML attribute snippets (IdP team can copy):
- `urn:oid:1.3.6.1.4.1.redwood:roles -> redwood:roles` (single value, comma-separated)
- `urn:oid:2.5.4.42 -> givenName`
- `urn:oid:2.5.4.4 -> familyName`

I'll be on the call Thurs to walk through the mapping if needed.
